deep.reconstruction: Section 2 of a set of Hilbert-space notes, following No. 1 on Hilbert-Schmidt and trace-class operators (L^2, L^1, Corollaries on Tr(vu) and the factorization u = VW). The page defines the Hilbert tensor product of finitely many Hilbert spaces E_1,...,E_n. On the algebraic tensor product one sets (a_1⊗...⊗a_n, b_1⊗...⊗b_n) = Π(a_i,b_i). As in No. 1, this extends to a positive-definite Hermitian sesquilinear form, giving a pre-Hilbert space. Its completion is denoted \hat⊗^{(2)} E_i, or \hat⊗^{n(2)} E when all factors equal E. If (e^i_{α_i}) is an orthonormal basis of E_i, then the elementary tensors e_α = e^1_{α_1}⊗...⊗e^n_{α_n}, α ∈ A_1×...×A_n, form an orthonormal basis, so the completion is ℓ^2(A_1×...×A_n). The left margin adds canonical associativity (and commutativity) isomorphisms between \hat⊗^{(2)}_{i∈I} E_i and \hat⊗^{(2)}_{I_1} ⊗ \hat⊗^{(2)}_{I_2}. For bounded operators u_i: E_i → F_i, the algebraic tensor product ⊗u_i is continuous for the Hilbert norms and ||u_1⊗...⊗u_n|| ≤ Π||u_i||. The proof reduces to the case where all but one u_i is the identity, writing ⊗u_i = U_1∘...∘U_n. On the next page this case is reduced to two factors and settled by identifying E_1 ⊗^{(2)} E_2 with Hilbert-Schmidt maps L^2(\bar E_1', E_2). The needed bound is then the ideal inequality ||u ∘ ^tA||_2 ≤ ||u||_2 ||A||, formula (17) of No. 1. The next page then introduces the antisymmetrizer a_n = (1/n!) Σ ε_σ σ on \hat⊗^{n(2)} E, i.e. Hilbert exterior powers. This prepares the 'inégalités diverses' of the title: Weyl/Carleman-type inequalities for singular values, eigenvalues and Fredholm determinants obtained via Λ^n u. This is the material Grothendieck later used in his Fredholm theory paper.
errors: No error. Inequality (2) is correct but not sharp: for Hilbert tensor products one actually has equality ||u_1⊗...⊗u_n|| = Π||u_i|| (≥ follows by testing on near-norming elementary tensors). The page states only ≤, which is all that is needed.

ideas.what: Hilbert tensor product of n Hilbert spaces via the product of inner products on elementary tensors; orthonormal basis indexed by the product of index sets
ideas.where_published: Grothendieck, Produits tensoriels topologiques et espaces nucléaires (Memoirs AMS 16, 1955), and the Fredholm paper (Bull. SMF 1956), where Hilbert tensor products are used

ideas.what: Norm bound for tensor products of operators, proved by reduction to u⊗1 and the Hilbert-Schmidt ideal inequality via E_1⊗E_2 ≅ HS(\bar E_1', E_2)
ideas.modern_name: cross-norm property of operator tensor products; HS ideal property

ideas.what: Antisymmetrizer on the Hilbert tensor power (next page), leading to exterior-power inequalities
ideas.modern_name: Hilbert exterior powers Λ^n E; Weyl–Horn singular value inequalities
ideas.where_published: Grothendieck, 'La théorie de Fredholm', Bull. SMF 84 (1956)

deep.surprise_reason: Standard textbook construction of Hilbert tensor products and the operator norm bound, preparing exterior-power inequalities that Grothendieck himself published in his Fredholm theory work. Of interest only as a draft of those texts.
